As a solo digital marketer, it's like having a writer, designer, and social manager in one platform. Genuinely life-changing. Questions? What exactly can Eva do with my inbox? Eva sorts and prioritizes your incoming email, filters out the junk and noise, drafts replies in your writing style, manages your calendar, and takes notes during your online meetings. The goal is simple: you wake up to an inbox that's already organized instead of overflowing. Can Eva send emails on my behalf? No — and that's by design. Eva prepares drafts directly in your inbox, but she can't hit send for you. You review each one and send it yourself, so you're always the one in control of what goes out under your name. Is my email and calendar data private and secure? Yes, and we take this seriously. Marblism uses top-tier encryption and meets global data protection standards. Your emails and calendar data are never stored or used to train third-party AI models, AI-generated content is visible only to you, and any administrative access on our side is strictly read-only and granted individually. Which email and calendar providers does Eva work with? Eva works with Gmail, Outlook, and any email provider that supports IMAP, along with Google and Outlook calendars. Most people are connected in just a few minutes. What happens to my inbox if I decide to stop using Eva? Nothing permanent. If you log into Marblism and delete your account, your inbox simply reverts to how it was before. You're not locked in, and you won't lose anything. How does Eva know which emails actually matter? Eva reads the content and sender of each message and sorts it into categories like "To Respond," "FYI," or "Marketing." You can choose the labels that fit how you work, and she adapts to your preferences over time, so the things that need you rise to the top and the noise stays out of the way. How long before my inbox is actually under control? Most people feel the difference within the first couple of weeks, and on average save more than two hours a day that used to disappear into email. Eva is included in every Marblism plan from $24/month on the yearly option, along with the rest of your AI team, and you can cancel anytime.
